answer: In PoA, bonded collateral escrows make each identity accountable: when k coordinated identities equivocate, correlated-fault penalties scale as O(k²), so splitting activity across keys does not dilute the loss. Detection also triggers an exponential multiplier in capital depreciation, making a sybil swarm increasingly costly to operate. Whether keys are labeled onyx, copper, or garden, their shared control exposes the whole coordinated set to correlated penalties.
